newsitem.title: USA: Inventory drop shrank revised US Q4 GDP estimate.
newsitem.headline: Inventory drop shrank revised US Q4 GDP estimate.

text.p: Inventory depletion produced much of the downward revision to fourth-quarter U.S. Gross Domestic Product (GDP) reported Friday, but economic growth should still moderate in the first quarter of 1997, economists said.

Fourth-quarter GDP growth was revised to a 3.9 percent annual rate, down from the Commerce Department's previous estimate of 4.7 percent. Wall Street economists in a Reuters poll had been expecting a slighty smaller revision, to about 4.1 percent.
